a new thermal model is proposed to simulate linear friction welding process, and the proposed model is more efficient than the oscillation thermal model.

the numerical simulation of the initial phase of linear friction welding of Ti 6 Al 4V alloy.
the simulation of the initial phase of the Linear Friction Weld process.

a fully coupled thermomechani-cal model can be used to simulate the initial (phase 1), friction (phase 2) and forging (phase 3) phases in a single simulation.
the initial phase of the process (phase 1, also called the conditioning phase) is not as important as the other phases in the process and can be neglected without affecting the overall results.
